gw.snowed_in_sleigh.title: The Snowed-In Sleigh
gw.snowed_in_sleigh.description: A bonus chapter: Grandpa's sleigh is stuck in the snow and the whole family has to dig it out before Christmas Eve.

gw.jingle_scarf.title: Jingle's Knitted Scarf
gw.jingle_scarf.description: A green knitted scarf for Jingle. It warms him up straight away, and he wears it for the rest of the night.
